items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And I remember that very vividly, and that was his input to it, but he took Dave Dexter to task for that pretty good for having the nerve to criticize anything the man played.

ctx.x: But Koetsabiskie (PHONETIC) -- Koetsabiskie wrote and answered Dave Dexter; that's when Dave was writing for the DownBeat. And like it went something like, "How dare you criticize a virtuoso such as Jimmy Blanton. If I had to say anything about the recording that he made, and I have everything he's ever done -- the only thing that I would suggest, because of the way he plays, I would suggest that he should record with a three quarter size bass instead of a full size bass."

And I remember that very vividly, and that was his input to it, but he took Dave Dexter to task for that pretty good for having the nerve to criticize anything the man played. He said nothing was wrong with his playing -- that it was the most beautiful playing he had ever heard in his life. He said it would be easier for him to record with a three quarter bass than it would -- but there's still nothing wrong with the full sized bass that he records with, but he said, as a technician, he happens to know that it…
